messages:
emma-security: Heads up — found an S3 backup (s3://redwood-backups/daily/2026-03-19.tar.gz) that contains an encrypted dump of DB creds. The file is KMS-encrypted but the key policy appears to include a service account that should have been scoped out. Need containment + rotation.
raj-sre: Thanks emma. How confident are we that ciphertext is not public-accessible? Can we check object ACLs + access logs?
emma-security: ACLs were private, but the bucket had a short-lived presigned URL created by a forgotten script; presigned usage logs show 3 external IPs accessed it between 03/19 02:10-02:17 UTC.
laura-ops: Ok that's actionable. First steps: 1) Immediately revoke the presigned URL usage (rotate creds used to generate it), 2) disable the SA that generated it if still present, 3) short-lived suspend any jobs that use that SA.
sam-eng: I'll take (1). Which creds generated the presigned URL? I can look up in the CI job history.
mia-pm: I'll coordinate customer-facing comms if needed, but want to confirm scope first.
emma-security: CI job id: ci/backup-everynight#4235 — job logs show it used service-account: backup-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
raj-sre: backup-runner had kms:EncryptDecrypt in the key policy for projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/data/cryptoKey/backups-key. That's too wide. Need to restrict and create a dedicated key for backups.
laura-ops: Decision: rotate DB credentials immediately, rewrap KMS material to a new key, and revoke the old SA access. Order: rotate DB creds -> update Vault with new secret -> re-encrypt blob or remove backups -> revoke SA and rotate KMS key policy.
sam-eng: For rewrap we can use aws/gcloud re-encrypt. Example (GCP):

```
gcloud kms keys versions create --key backup-key --location global --keyring data
# or use EKM/CloudKMS rewrap flow via API
```

But we need a short runbook for Vault integration. vault-bot: Suggest using transit rewrap: `vault write transit/rewrap backup-ciphertext ciphertext=<blob>` and then store output.
emma-security: Action items and owners:
- sam-eng: suspend backup job, rotate the CI token used to create presigned URLs (complete in 15m)
- laura-ops: rotate DB credentials and place new creds in Vault (complete in 30m)
- raj-sre: create new KMS key (backups-key-v2) with locked-down policy and assist with rewrap (complete in 45m)
- mia-pm: keep stakeholders informed (ETA 1h)
- emma-security: run audit queries for key usage + external IPs and prepare list of exposures

raj-sre: For RBAC: new policy should be least-privilege: only backup-runner role (and ops emergency group) can Encrypt, but Decrypt should be limited to Vault transit or a specific runtime identity. We'll also add key rotation schedule.
laura-ops: After DB credential rotation, rotate any long-lived tokens that used those creds (e.g., analytics read-only accounts). We'll compile a list.
sam-eng: Confirmed CI token rotated and backup job paused. I uploaded a temp lockfile at /tmp/backup-lock. No new presigned URLs can be generated.
emma-security: Audit results: external IPs traced to 3th-party IP ranges. No confirmed malicious activity beyond the GETs. We'll treat as potential compromise. List of services using affected DB cred: app-prod, ad-hoc-reporting, analytics-puller.
mia-pm: We may need to notify legal if customer data in any of these backups — flagged a check with data-classification team.
laura-ops: DB creds rotated, new credentials written to Vault at secret/data/prod/db-primary (versioned). I rotated DB password and updated app-prod deployment with a rolling restart.
vault-bot: Transit rewrap completed for dumped ciphertext. New ciphertext reference stored in secure bucket s3://redwood-secrets-rewrap/2034567890/ciphertext.enc
raj-sre: I created backups-key-v2 and updated key policy to remove broad SA bindings. Also created a temporary grant for vault-transit-service-account via IAM conditions. Will re-evaluate permanent policy after compliance review.
emma-security: Next: schedule forced rewrap/cleanup of older backups (7-day retention for rewrap), add automated scan to CI for accidental presigned-url use, and add alert when KMS key policy changes.
sam-eng: Opened an incident runbook ticket: INC-2026-0319-rotations and a follow-up task to scrub CI logs for other uses. I'll add remediation checklist.
mia-pm: I'll prepare a short internal update for execs and a draft for legal if needed. ETA 2h for full summary.
laura-ops: Postmortem owners? emma-security + raj-sre + laura-ops + sam-eng. We'll schedule a blameless postmortem and add prevention items (CI secret scoping, presign TTL limits, Vault-only decrypts).
emma-security: OK — thanks team. Will keep this thread updated. :lock:
audit-bot: Audit log snapshot saved to gs://redwood-audit-snapshots/2034567890.json"
